statusPoll.contract: A since request returns exactly one of: {layoutId,version,seq,changed:false} when since===seq, or {layoutId,version,seq,changed:true,statuses} otherwise (owner side adds pending). Never the full payload, never an image or poly. statuses covers every kind:plot plot, not a delta.

versionBump.note: After a publish the live layout is a new document and its seq is old seq + 1. The poll still answers changed:true with the new layoutId/version; the client sees the layoutId/version differ from what it holds, ignores statuses and fetches the full payload.

clientRules: Poll E1/E2 every 30 s with ?since=<seq of the last full payload or poll>.
If response.layoutId or response.version differs from the held values: discard local state, fetch the full payload (no since), ignore statuses.

Else if changed:true: repaint every plot from statuses and store seq. Owner side then also fetches the full payload once. A broker with at least one own pending request also fetches the full payload once.
Socket events only trigger the same actions earlier; polling alone is sufficient.
